newsitem.title: USA: Dow index ends above 6,300 for first time.
newsitem.headline: Dow index ends above 6,300 for first time.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average closed above 6,300 points for the first time Thursday as the latest good news on the inflation front energized the blue-chip index to its seventh record finish in a row.
Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow ended up 38.76 points at 6,313.00, beating Wednesday's milestone of 6,274.24 and matching the unbroken string of highs set in February.
In the broader market, advancing issues led declines 14-9 on active volume of 480 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
